verdict.rationale: Skyfire's pay and kya-pay tokens are signed, scoped credentials the agent uses instead of a card number. Each token commits a fixed amount against the buyer's wallet as a hard ceiling, and overcharges are rejected with a 402. Tokens expire within 10 seconds to 24 hours, each authorizes payment to a seller, and card-based purchases use tokenized cards under cardholder authorizations bound to a merchant and an amount. Missing for 10: no per-token revocation API (outstanding tokens stay chargeable until expiry plus a 24-hour grace period), merchant binding for wallet pay tokens is only briefly stated, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of limit enforcement.
